data: Unmodified LTAF real ECG from TS-Haystack linked raw repository; eight lexicographically first official test record IDs. Official clinical QA metadata audited separately, never treated as numeric event labels.
windows: One nonoverlapping context of each length per recording. Start offsets 0,16384,147456. Ten public numeric questions per context = 240 questions, 24 contexts, eight independent record clusters. No train/test overlap; no model training or parameter search.
event_definition: Maximal contiguous samples with x>=threshold; not clinical rhythms, R peaks or disease labels. No minimum-width gate or synthetic insertion. Thresholds 0.5 and 1.0 in released numeric signal units fixed before reading test raw observations.
fixed_representations: Uniform, PAA, MinMax, PLA with measured sup error, SAX; official TT-SAX on supported trend encoding. Nominal target float32 byte compression; actual bytes include all values, bound arrays, normalization metadata and symbolic words. No claim that equal block width means equal budget.
hierarchy: MinMax+Sum binary tree; leaf width 2*nominal ratio. Report all internal index bytes and build time. Query-aware branch-and-bound uses only index values, never answers. Raw access through counted broker only.
event_index: Offline threshold-run index at two predeclared thresholds and both channels, plus ordinary maximum/argmax and half sums. Exact only for this declared workload. Report complete build scan and storage; do not generalize to unknown clinical labels or arbitrary future thresholds.
identifiability: Report decoder disagreement separately from proven ambiguity or sufficient certificates. PAA/TT-SAX are functions of block means; same block sums permit within-block permutations. Uniform hides unsampled points. MinMax cannot determine internal event count/order without positions. Do not equate decoder error with mathematical information loss.
statistics: Pair conditions within contexts, uncertainty resampling over record IDs (eight clusters), not 240 independent subjects. No outcome-based sample replacement.
sota: Inspect all six official sources. Run TT-SAX reference encoding and supported native shape search smoke. Attempt existing Sonar-TS official pipeline with local Qwen on new native numeric tasks then unified numeric ECG pilot; label adapted backbone and workload. No paid APIs or new training. ARTS/TimeRLM blockers must be explicit, not assigned fabricated scores.
